data.name: Ocean Fishooter
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the Thrilling New World of <Ocean Fishooter>

After years of dedication and passion, we're thrilled to unveil our most magnificent creation yet—a fishing adventure like no other!

[Why You'll Love Ocean Fishooter]

Shoot, Score, and Conquer!

Arm your cannon, take aim, and fire at a dazzling variety of sea creatures. Reel in big wins with every shot and dominate the deep!

【Enhanced Fishing Gameplay】

The era of Strategic Fishing is here! Your choice of firepower determines your victory!

Phonix Power (Single Target Annihilation): Target locked! Summon a Fire Phoenix with a 5x Reinforced Bullet to focus fire directly on the Boss's weak point, dramatically reducing kill time!

Dragon Power (Area Sweep): Area bombardment! A 7x Reinforced Bullet triggers chain lightning, its widespread attack leaving no small fish hidden, easily achieving a clean sweep!

【Mighty Bosses】

Fortune King: 【Treasure Bag Draw!】 Chance to pull a multiplying "Golden Dragon" or a prize-winning "Koi"! Experience the thrill of opening a lucky chest!

Coin Clown: 【Hat Trick】 The surprises never stop! The unpredictable jester's magic randomly conjures a multiplying "Tiger King" or a prize-winning "Rabbit"!

Raging Dragon: 【Go All Out!】 Capture the Dragon and don't let it break free from its chains! Test your sustained firepower and precision!

Vampire King: 【Multiplier Accumulation】 Continuous shooting builds up the prize pool! After the final kill, the accumulated prize is multiplied for a massive burst of earnings!

Rock Skeleton: 【Sound & Light Shockwave】 Cool concert-level special effects! The sonic shockwave causes area damage! Rock!

Tiger King: 【Speed Rush】 Challenge your ultimate reaction time! The more fire rings you fly through, the more prizes you accumulate. Go for the rush!

Thunder Dragon: 【Full-Screen Lightning】 Attacking from all sides! The Thunder Dragon's impact triggers full-screen lightning strikes, resulting in first-class group damage efficiency!

【Rich Marine Life】

Stunning! Dive into the deep-sea sanctuary and embark on a "True-to-Life" visual fishing feast!

We've invested heavily to create over dozens of lifelike marine species, ensuring you never face monotony—every shot is a surprising encounter!

【Vibrant & Colorful! Reef Sparklers】 From the lively Clownfish and graceful Angelfish to the mysterious Lanternfish. These high-frequency species are your best choice for accumulating small prizes! (Includes: Lionfish, Flounder, Lobster, Swordfish, Octopus, Sea Turtle, Crab, Manta Ray...etc.)

【Deep-Sea Giants! A Challenge of Sight and Firepower】 Get ready to face the true ocean dominators! Fierce Sharks, massive Humpback Whales, elegant and mysterious Mermaids, and lurking Crocodiles—these large targets not only bring intense visual shock but are also the primary source of big jackpots!

【Fortune Zombie】

Enter a post-apocalyptic world where the undead roam and survival is the only goal. Face terrifying foes, each with their own tragic story.

INFERNODRAC：A noble vampire count who transforms into a well of blood beneath the moonlight.

DOOMTRAIN：A devoted conductor who keeps managing the train station—even after infection.

FERRIS WHEEL：A carnival performer who turns his hand drum to spin his beloved wheel.

MECHZOMB：A monstrous Frankenstein zombie with giant mechanical arms crushing all in its path.

LUNORIA：A silent soul who waits eternally for the love she could never forget.

MECKONG：A mechanical gorilla destroying bridges and annihilating intruders.

GRIMBADGE：A brutal prison warden from whom no prisoner has ever escaped.

【Dino Shooter】

Travel back to a primal world where dinosaurs roam free! Gear up for a prehistoric adventure like never before.

Encounter a variety of ancient beasts in lush, untamed lands.

Hunt down mythical creatures like the Crystal Dragon and Gigantic Golden Dragon!

【Lucky Shooter】

Step into a whimsical fairytale kingdom filled with magical creatures and thrilling challenges.

Defend your enchanted castle from beneath the moat.

Discover the wonder and mystery of a world beyond imagination!

【Diverse Welfare & Benefits】

Luxury Login Rewards: Sign in consecutively for seven days to unlock an exclusive rare wing grand prize!

Lucky Wheel: Test your luck for free! Massive amounts of Gold and Diamonds are waiting for you to spin out!

Monthly Pass: Upgrade to the VIP Monthly Pass to enjoy an ad-free experience and early access to unlock game levels for the ultimate fishing journey!

【Diverse Level Design】

Quiet Deep Sea: Feel the calmness and mystery of the deep sea, searching for big prizes lurking in the deep blue.

Rock Stage: Follow the rhythm of the Rock Skeleton! Fire away on a stage filled with sound and light shockwaves for the wildest fishing night!

Crazy Circus: Enter the domain of the Coin Clown and Tiger King! Challenge thrilling, high-multiplier prizes in the bizarre and festive setting!

Ice Canyon: Delve into the habitat of the Ancient Crocodile! Test your extreme firepower in the cold, chilling ancient canyon.

Lava Volcano: Challenge the lair of the Raging Dragon! Engage in an all-out ultimate hunt within the environment of the searing volcanic lava!

Note

● Ocean Fishooter does not offer real money gambling. It is intended for an adult audience for entertainment purposes only.

● Any success in social casino gambling is not indicative of future success at real money gambling.

● This game includes in-app purchases.
